question: Does the released DSTFormer retain useful temporal evidence in its 2048-D representation immediately before fc2 that is lost in the 40-D frame logits?
single_change: The residual TCN reads a fold-train PCA projection of the 2048-D pre-fc2 frame representation instead of the 40-D frame logits.

pca_protocol.fit_rows: all 16 frames from outer-training users only

unchanged.frame_logits_and_features: exported by the same forward pass
unchanged.static_path: mean of the same 16 frame logits
unchanged.temporal_recipe: same TCN, five epochs, 30-epoch cosine period, fixed final checkpoint

stopping_rule: If the candidate fails, lower the priority of the 40-D classification bottleneck hypothesis; do not scan PCA widths or replace PCA with attention in this experiment family.
local_view_rule: Do not train a local-view model unless an original-frame audit first demonstrates crop, resolution, or 16-frame sampling loss.
